newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB says gains Taiwan OBU licence.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB says gains Taiwan OBU licence.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Monday it had been granted a licence to operate an offshore banking unit (OBU) in Taiwan.

The licence upgrades the status of NAB's Taiwan branch, which has offered mainly wholesale services since the mid 1980s, allowing it to borrow foreign currencies in its own right and on-lend to resident and non-resident customers, an NAB spokesman said.
Two-way trade flows between Taiwan, Australia and New Zealand totalled more than US$5 billion in calendar 1995, NAB said.
NAB also has applied for an offshore banking licence in Thailand and awaits an official decision from the Thai government.
